title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Create purchase quotes for contacts (without a vendor)
summary: Starting with BC28 (2026 release wave 1), you can create purchase quotes for contacts without requiring a vendor record first. When converting the quote to an order, Business Central automatically creates a vendor using a template based on contact details.
key_points: Purchase quotes can now be created for contacts not yet associated with vendors, eliminating the need for pre-setup
Team Members license users can now create sales or purchase quotes
Upon quote conversion or release, Business Central automatically generates a vendor record using a vendor template
The appropriate template is selected based on territory code, country/region code, and contact type from the contact record
features: Team Members license support for quotes

quotes.text: You can create purchase quotes for contacts that aren't yet associated with a vendor.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core feature enabling preliminary purchasing discussion without vendor record setup

quotes.text: When you convert the quote into an order or release the document, Business Central automatically creates the vendor using a vendor template.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the workflow mechanics and how vendor records are generated from quote conversion

quotes.text: Team Members license can also be used to create sales or purchase quotes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies licensing eligibility for the new purchase quote capability
